Original Text: One might say that the Monster Prom had hardened us on the highs and lows of love.

Speaker: narrator
Translated Text: Но нет — в любви мы всегда полные новички.

Speaker: narrator
Translated Text: И летний лагерь не стал исключением.

Translated Text: Никто не говорил об этом вслух, но мысль о летнем романе так и витала в воздухе.

Translated Text: Все знали: если тебе кто-то нравится, вы просто обязаны посмотреть на эту чертовщину вместе.

Speaker: narrator
Translated Text: И вот нас охватило незримое, но сильное напряжение. Всё повторялось точь-в-точь как на Монстровыпускном...
Original Text: And so, a silent yet powerful pressure invaded us. It was the Monster Prom all over again...

Speaker: narrator
Translated Text: Всё казалось таким неопределённым... всё, кроме одного: кого бы мы ни позвали на свидание под звездопадом, это наверняка был бы кто-то из шестёрки самых крутых ребят в том автобусе:
Original Text: Everything seemed uncertain.... everything but one thing: whoever we were asking on a meteor shower date, it was probably going to be one of the six coolest people on that bus:

Speaker: narrator
Translated Text: Джой Джонсон-Джоджима (23), крутая ведьма, которая захотела немного отдохнуть после бесчисленных спасений мира.
Original Text: Joy Johnson-Johjima (23), a badass witch who wanted to chill a bit after saving the world countless times.

Speaker: narrator
Translated Text: Аарави Мишра (22), вспыльчивая искательница приключений, одержимая проклятием, которая оказалась самой невыносимой соседкой по комнате на свете.
Original Text: Aaravi Mishra (22), a hotheaded adventurer possessed by a curse who had turned out to be the most annoying roommate ever.

Speaker: narrator
Translated Text: Калькулестер Хьюлетт-Паккард (v1.1), библиотечный компьютер, ставший разумным роботом, готовым прочувствовать жизнь на полную катушку.
Original Text: Calculester Hewlett-Packard (v1.1), a library computer who had become a sentient robot ready to experience life to its fullest.

Speaker: narrator
Translated Text: Далия Акино (20), накачанная синяя демоница и разжигательница войн, которая теперь нацелилась покорить лето.
Original Text: Dahlia Aquino (20), a buff blue demon and warmonger who had set her sights on conquering summer next.

Speaker: narrator
Translated Text: Дэмиен Лавей (21), бесстрашный демон со страстью к разрушениям и любовью к огню.
Original Text: Damien LaVey (21), a fearless demon with a taste for destruction and a love of fire.

Speaker: narrator
Translated Text: И Майло Белладонна (23?), жнец смерти, подрабатывающий интернет-инфлюенсером и без памяти влюблённый в жизнь и все её земные удовольствия.
Original Text: And Milo Belladonna (23?), a death reaper doubling as an Internet influencer, and who was profoundly in love with life and all its earthly pleasures.

Speaker: narrator
Translated Text: Поездка на автобусе предстояла долгая, и от удачного первого шага могло зависеть всё лето.
Original Text: The bus trip was long, and all of summer could be shaped by the first step well-taken.

Speaker: narrator
Translated Text: И поэтому стало ясно: всё сводилось к тому, чтобы растопить лёд и произвести хорошее впечатление на нужного человека.
Original Text: And so it was clear: it all came down to breaking the ice and causing a good impression with the right person.

Speaker: narrator
Translated Text: У нас оставалось всего %WEEKS% нед., чтобы добиться расположения тех, кто нам нравится, и покорить их сердца!

Translated Text: Но как я уже сказал: мы были молоды и бесстрашны... и были готовы начать.
Original Text: But as I already said: we were young and unafraid... and we were ready to start.

Speaker: narrator
Translated Text: ------Во время похода по лесу вы натыкаетесь на кучу вкусных съедобных грибов!
Original Text: While hiking through the woods, you come across a bunch of delicious edible mushrooms!

Translated Text: Ну... вы, во всяком случае, считаете их съедобными. В смысле, вы их съели.

Speaker: narrator
Translated Text: Совершенно не по теме, вы также встречаете древнего всемогущего бога, обладающего непреходящим разумом и почему-то очень увлеченного вейпорвейвом.
Original Text: On a completely unrelated note, you also meet an ancient all-powerful god who's timelessly intelligent, and also really into vaporwave for some reason.

Speaker: narrator
Translated Text: Ты получаешь +2 СООБРАЗИТЕЛЬНОСТЬ за крутой разговор с богом вейпорвейва!
Original Text: You gain +2 SMARTS from your dope conversation with the vaporwave god!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: During your hike through the woods, you find a baby bird that's fallen out of his nest!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You nurse him back to health with some delicious trail mix. You also give him some great advice on puberty and how to do his taxes when he grows up.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Then the mama bird finds you... and she is PISSED that you're holding her baby. She tries to peck your eyes out, but you fight her off!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You've learned an important lesson today: don't fuck with birds. You gain +2 SMARTS.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Today you decide to hike ALL THE WAY across the woods. You wanna see what's on the other side!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: It's a long, treacherous hike... that ends up only taking an hour. I guess these woods aren't that big after all. How do you and your friends get lost in them so often?

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Anyway, it turns out there's a library on the other side of the woods. You go in and read some books or something and gain +2 SMARTS!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: That day, you get lost hiking in the woods. You use the stars, AKA nature's compass, to get back to camp.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: The stars actually teach you all sorts of things! Like how one of the stars in Orion's belt is actually a nebula!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: The stars also teach you Italian, the quadratic formula, and the true meaning of friendship!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Wow, the stars sure are smart! And they give you +2 SMARTS!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: While you're hiking through the woods, you accidentally step on a pile of leaves covering a MASSIVE HOLE!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: IT WAS A TRAP! An evil goblin hunter (is it a goblin who hunts or someone who hunts goblins? YOU'LL NEVER KNOW) appears. They were the one who put the trap in there.

Speaker: narrator

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: They'll only let you leave if you help them. You don't have any other option here. It's a bit boring, but you actually learn some useful calculus. You gain +2 SMARTS.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You hike deep into the woods and find a mysterious journal with the number 3 on it half-buried in the dirt!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Inside is tons of information on local monsters and how to defeat them. It covers gnomes, psychics, time-travelers, Illuminati-shaped demons...

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: ...What a boring journal! Where's the drama? Where's the inner thoughts and insecurities about school crushes?!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Whoever wrote this journal knew nothing about how journals work. You gain no FUN from this, but you surely get +2 SMARTS. Boring.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: That day you go on a hiking trip with a bunch of random campers. You live some weird adventures and share personal stories and secrets.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You don't know their names and they don't seem to have their own character models. But they reveal to you they're part of a different game, a survival resource-managing one.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: It turns out they cannot perceive YOUR character model. You go to the same camp, yet you're part of different games.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: This is deeply strange, and makes you reflect so much about your own existence that you gain +2 SMARTS out of it.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: They apparently gain +10 BERRIES and +2 STAMINA, whatever that means.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: That day you go searching the woods for edible wildflowers to make a delicious wildflower soup.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You heard that some well-known flowers like lilies and tulips are actually poisonous! You decide to find out which flowers are bad by eating them all.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: A few hours later, you've vomited up all the contents of your stomach and have a comprehensive list of which flowers NOT to put in the soup next time. Nice! You gain +2 SMARTS.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: WILDFLOWER SOUP FOREVER!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: That day you go to the woods searching for edible roots to make a wilderness tea.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You find lots of roots! Beetroot, ginger root, the square root of pi, the root of all evil...

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You brew it all together, and it's the most delicious tea you've ever had! It's so "rooted" with knowledge that you gain +2 SMARTS.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: That day you get lost in the woods.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You decide to study the trees' bark and moss patterns to solve the situation.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: By reading one tree's bark, you realize which direction North is!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: By reading another tree's bark, you learn the exact age of the tree (73 years old).

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: By reading yet another tree's bark, you learn the tree likes Irish poetry and believes Buffy and Spike were the ultimate ship on Buffy the Vampire Slayer.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Woah! So much useless knowledge! You gain +2 SMARTS.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: That day while you're hiking through the woods, an angry gnome steps into your path!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: HALT, GIANT BEAST! he cries. "If it is passage you seek, you must first answer my riddles three!"

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Riddle number one: how is a raven like a writing desk?

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Hmmm... that's a tough call, but you give your answer: you punt the gnome into the sky and continue on your merry way.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Apparently that was the correct response, because nobody else tries to fuck with you! You gain +2 SMARTS.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: That day in the woods, you find a mysterious portal to an unknown dimension! WHOA!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You're not so stupid that you'd jump into it yourself (this time), so you decide to tie a chipmunk to a string and throw it in there.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You pull the chipmunk back, expecting it to be dead or at least warped by the interdimensional travel, but it turns out whatever is on the other side of that portal taught the chipmunk calculus and some very cogent arguments about gender identity!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You and the chipmunk have a long, insightful conversation, and he helps you with your summer school homework. You gain +2 SMARTS!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: That day while hiking through the woods, you find a tree with the words "J + S 4EVER" carved on it. Awww!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Then on another tree you find "J IS A LIAR AND A CHEATING HO". That's... less cute.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Then on yet ANOTHER tree you find "S I KNOW YOU BANGED LIKE 12 PEOPLE ABROAD IN EUROPE DON'T DISH WHAT YOU CAN'T TAKE".

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: On the last tree, S doxxes J. It turns out J lives on 7889 +2SMARTS Lane.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Boy, you sure can learn a lot from trees!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: While hiking through the woods, you're approached by an NPC who has a quest for you. You can tell she's an NPC because she only says the same four things over and over and keeps doing the same idle animation.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: The NPC's quest is to deliver a very important scroll to her father. She makes it extremely clear that NO ONE ELSE is allowed to read it, or terrible things will happen!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You read it, ofc. It turns out it's her father's secret recipe to the perfect peach cobbler!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Looks like her dad is never going to make that famed dessert in time for the NPC family potluck, because you eat the recipe scroll and gain +2 SMARTS!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: While you're hiking through the woods, you find a little clearing with a beautiful blue pond.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: There's a very handsome man staring deeply into the pond. He's talking to his reflection like it's another person... a person he REALLY wants to fuck.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You swipe his wallet while he's not looking and find out his name is Narcissus, he is NOT an organ donor (asshole), and he's one punch away from getting a free SmartWater at 7/11.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Well, he's definitely not going to be using that anytime soon! You head to the gas station and gain +2 SMARTS from your SmartWater!

Speaker: narrator
Translated Text: В тот день ты решаешься заглянуть в Особняк с привидениями, чтобы доказать, что ты вовсе не трусишка.
Original Text: That day you venture into the Haunted Manor to prove that you're not a little scaredy-cat.

Speaker: narrator
Translated Text: Особняк превращается в извилистый лабиринт, из которого нет выхода. Ты застрянешь здесь... НАВСЕГДА!
Original Text: The manor transforms itself into a winding maze from which there is no escape. You'll be trapped here... FOREVER!

Speaker: narrator
Translated Text: К счастью, ты прихватил%PRN__а_и% с собой телефон и немного перекусить, поэтому просто садишься и раскладываешь пасьянс, пока дому не становится с тобой скучно и он сам не показывает тебе выход.
Original Text: Luckily, you brought your phone and some snacks, so you sit down and play Solitaire until the house gets bored of you and shows you the exit.

Speaker: narrator
Translated Text: Оказывается, лучшая защита от сверхъестественного — это полная апатия! Ты получаешь +2 СМЕЛОСТЬ.
Original Text: It turns out the best defense against the supernatural is total apathy! You gain +2 BOLDNESS.

Speaker: narrator
Translated Text: В тот день в Особняке с привидениями к тебе на трехколесном велосипеде подъезжает маленький клоун и спрашивает, не хочешь ли ты сыграть в игру.

Speaker: narrator
Translated Text: Круто, ты обожаешь игры! Ты предлагаешь «Монополию» или «Города». Клоун отвечает, что тебе нужно найти ключ от выхода за час, иначе он сдерет с тебя всю кожу.
Original Text: Cool, you love games! You suggest Monopoly or Scattergories. The clown-man tells you to find the exit key in an hour or he's going to rip all your skin off.

Speaker: narrator
Translated Text: Тебе эта идея не особо по душе, поэтому вы решаете пойти на компромисс и отправиться в квест-комнату, чтобы вместе решить несколько головоломок.
Original Text: You're not super into that idea, so you two decide to compromise by going to an escape room and solving some puzzles together.

Speaker: narrator
Translated Text: Это было очень задорно! Но здесь ты получаешь не ЗАДОР. Вместо этого ты получаешь +2 СМЕЛОСТЬ.
Original Text: It's lots of fun! But you don't gain FUN here. You gain +2 BOLDNESS instead.

Speaker: narrator
Translated Text: Исследуя Особняк с привидениями, ты находишь зачарованный череп, который говорит загадками. От его голоса у тебя идет кровь из ушей.
Original Text: While exploring the Haunted Manor, you find an enchanted skull who speaks in riddles. His voice makes your ears bleed.

Speaker: narrator
Translated Text: Ты решаешь назвать его Спарки и вешаешь на брелок для ключей как забавного питомца.
Original Text: You decide to name him Sparky and put him on your keychain as a fun pet.

Speaker: narrator
Translated Text: Он рассказывает тебе кучу крутых штук — например: "Остерегайся приливов Венеры" или "Если встретишь в супермаркете парня по имени Ленни, не давай ему двадцать баксов".
Original Text: He tells you all sorts of cool things, like "Beware the tides of Venus," and "If you meet a guy named Lenny at Costco, don't give him twenty dollars."

Speaker: narrator
Translated Text: Еще Спарки в точности предсказывает, когда и как ты умрешь! Судя по всему, в этом будет замешано ОЧЕНЬ МНОГО сырных палочек. За такое предвидение ты получаешь +2 СМЕЛОСТЬ.
Original Text: Sparky also tells you exactly when and how you'll die! Apparently it's gonna involve a LOT of mozzarella sticks. You gain +2 BOLDNESS for gaining that foresight.

Speaker: narrator
Translated Text: В тот день ты находишь в Особняке с привидениями зеркало. Но вместо твоего отражения в нем появляется твоя гротескная злая версия.
Original Text: That day, you find a mirror in the Haunted Manor. But instead of showing your reflection, it shows you an exaggerated evil version of yourself.

Speaker: narrator
Translated Text: Злое "Я" говорит: "Тебе никогда не побороть свои комплексы. Посмотри на мое совершенство и на свои недостатки. Тебя никто и никогда не полюбит".
Original Text: Evil You says, "You will never surmount your insecurities. Look at how perfect I am, and look at how flawed you are. Nobody will ever love you."

Speaker: narrator
Translated Text: Контраргумент: многие из твоих так называемых "недостатков" целиком выдуманы жадными корпорациями, которые хотят нажиться, обещая "исправить" то, на что ты буквально не можешь повлиять.
Original Text: Counterpoint: many of your perceived "flaws" are totally fabricated by greedy companies looking to make a profit by promising to "fix" things you literally can't control.

Speaker: narrator
Translated Text: Как только ты это произносишь, Злое "Я" испускает истошный вопль и исчезает. Класс! Ты получаешь +2 СМЕЛОСТЬ, потому что ты потрясающий человек — такой, какой есть.
Original Text: As soon as you say that, Evil You shrieks bloody murder and disappears. Nice! You gain +2 BOLDNESS because you're amazing just the way you are.

Speaker: narrator
Translated Text: Блуждая по Особняку с привидениями, ты попадаешь в засаду группы злых духов!
Original Text: While wandering the Haunted Manor, you're ambushed by a group of evil spirits!

Speaker: narrator
Translated Text: Ты даешь им достойный отпор, но их слишком много, и они сбегают, ПРИХВАТИВ ТВОЮ БЕССМЕРТНУЮ ДУШУ.
Original Text: You put up a good fight, but there's just too many of them, and they run away WITH YOUR IMMORTAL SOUL.

Speaker: narrator
Translated Text: К счастью, ты всегда знал%PRN__а_и%, что этот день настанет, и много лет назад заменил%PRN__а_и% свою бессмертную душу плюшевой игрушкой.
Original Text: Luckily you always knew this day would come, and you replaced your immortal soul with a Beanie Baby years ago.

Speaker: narrator
Translated Text: Отличная предусмотрительность с твоей стороны! Ты получаешь +2 СМЕЛОСТЬ!
Original Text: Good foresight on your part! You gain +2 BOLDNESS!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: As you're searching the Haunted Manor, you come across an enchanted doll that promises to grant all your wishes!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Cool! You take it. It possesses you, of course.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: It turns out the spirit that was inside it is exactly like you in every way, so nobody notices the difference.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: The only difference is that this spirit is a little bit bolder than you -- so you basically gain +2 BOLDNESS!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You go to the Haunted Manor to gain some boldness, since you found a brochure that promised some boldness if you visited.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Instead you find a mischievous demon. It was all a ruse to lure you here. The demon will take nine years of your life.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You take the demon to court for misleading advertising.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: The jury isn't fond of mischievous demons who fool people into giving years of their life up, so you win and the demon has to give you +2 BOLDNESS. Fuck yeah!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: While you're exploring the Haunted Manor, you hear a voice calling your name. It comes from under the bed.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Two blood-red eyes stare at you from the inky darkness under the bed. A voice that sounds older than time whispers:

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Do you want to gain some boldness, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You say "yes", because you actually do want that.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: OK, here you go. Whatever that thing is, it gives you +2 BOLDNESS. What a nice under-the-bed-thing!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: In the Haunted Manor, a voice whispers from the walls in a frightening voice:

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%... you can't escape your fate... you'll soon gain BOLDNESS... but after that something WEIRD will happen to you... it could be great... OR TERRIBLE...

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You don't want something potentially terrible happening to you. You stay put to be sure you don't get extra BOLDNESS per the voice's prediction.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Look at you, trying to defy destiny itself! That takes some bravery. Here, have +2 BOLDNESS.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: That day you venture into the Haunted Manor.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Everything is going fine and you're reassured on how brave you are...

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: ...when suddenly a ghost (or is it just someone wearing a blanket with 2 holes? So hard to tell the difference) appears and whispers in your ear:

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Remember one day you will be long gone and no one will remember you. All the struggle you endure to become a better version of yourself both personally and professionally will eventually mean nothing.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: The ghost leaves while you take all that in, gaining +2 BOLDNESS in the process.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: That day you explore the Haunted Manor's basement, only to find it has a sub-basement.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: The sub-basement is full of haunted chairs and a staircase to a sub-sub-basement. The sub-sub-basement is a haunted wine cellar.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: The sub-sub-sub-basement is a haunted nightclub for ghosts who don't like wine. They serve haunted spirits! HA!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: The sub-basement to the tenth power is a Subway. You eat a footlong reuben and continue your travels.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You eventually check a walkthrough and find out the Haunted Manor can spawn an infinite amount of sub-basements. You only make it as far as the 89th level, which is a dom-sub leather room. You gain +2 BOLDNESS from the horrors you witness there.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: That day in the Haunted Manor, you accidentally stumble upon a cult meeting in the hallway!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: The cultists are wearing terrifying black robes, standing over a bloodied body and chanting. You try to flee, but one of them shoves a flyer in your hand.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: The ink burns your eyes to read, but you manage to find the words "NEW RECRUITS GET HEALTHCARE BENEFITS WITH SAME-DAY SIGN UP."

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: WHAT?! Sold! You gain a bunch of new cultist buddies, and your new insurance covers spontaneous +2 BOLDNESS growths! Cool!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You decide to get your tarot cards read while you're in the Haunted Manor. The wicked old lady who offers you the service said it'd be fun!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: The first card she flips over shows a photorealistic drawing of you flying on a hang glider directly into power lines.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: ...Is that good? you ask the psychic.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: She wordlessly puts her cards away and vanishes into the darkness. It's probably fine! You gain +2 BOLDNESS and a fun new phobia.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: That day in the Haunted Manor, you find a bunch of ghosts playing craps. You're terrible at gambling, but that's never stopped you before!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You face off against the craps champion, slam all of your chips down on the table, and cry out, "I BET MY IMMORTAL SOUL!!!"

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Everyone gasps... and then someone says, "Dude, chill. We're just, like, playing to have fun. Nobody's even betting real money."

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Oh! You're not used to such low-stakes betting around camp -- honestly, it's a relief. You bet +2 BOLDNESS against the champion instead... and you win!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You go into the Haunted Manor with a group, only to immediately split up once you get inside, as is customary.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You quickly get lost and have no cell signal, but in a stroke of genius, you follow the signs to the Haunted Manor's lost and found to wait for your friends to pick you up.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You find all sorts of cool lost knick-knacks while you wait! Some bloody gloves, a haunted iPod (it only plays "Thriller" by Michael Jackson), a totally normal Furby that still manages to be the creepiest thing in there...

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: At the bottom of the box, you even find +2 BOLDNESS! YOINK! Who in their right mind would throw that away?

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: That day you decide to take a swimming class in the lake. You learn all sorts of cool swimming techniques!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: The backstroke! The side stroke! The Macarena stroke! The mime-having-a stroke!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: All those strokes sure are fun! (Though perhaps a bit medically concerning.) You gain +2 FUN.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You want to go swimming, but it seems like the God of the Lake is in a bit of a mood today. It demands an offering before you can get in the water!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: The only thing you have to give is your favorite yo-yo, which you were playing with on the way here.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: The God of the Lake accepts your humble gift, and is actually kind of relieved you didn't leave something boring like a dead fish or the soul of a mortal.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: So in addition to gaining access to the lake, the God blesses you with +2 FUN! Yay!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: That day, you decide to go scuba diving and find a treasure chest at the bottom of the lake! WHOA!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You pick the lock, which is quite impressive if you keep in mind that you're still underwater. Inside you find... OVER 1000 FUN!!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Unfortunately, your wetsuit doesn't have pockets, so you can only go back to shore only with +2 FUN. When you go back, fish have eaten the rest. They're having a rave right now.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Fucking fish.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You decide to go relax in the lake for a bit. Camp Spooky gets pretty crazy, so it's nice to just float on the water and chill.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You end up falling asleep... and wake up to realize you've floated halfway across the lake straight into a CRAB RAVE?!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: The crabs are just as confused as you are, but they invite you to rave with them, and their party is surprisingly popping!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You gain +1 INVITE to the next crab rave, and +2 FUN!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: That day you go diving to see what's at the bottom of the lake.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You find a comic book! You pick it up, but it's so interesting you stay there reading it. This is bad, since you cannot hold your breath indefinitely.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You rush to the surface, but before getting there you drown a little and some lake water gets into your mouth. Gross!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You swallow some weird stuff that was in the lake water, like a whole jellyfish and... +2 FUN? What was that doing there?

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Before you go to the lake, you decide to make the most fun inflatable toy to float on that you possibly can.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You combine many of your favorite "fun" things: ice cream, tabletop games, watching your enemies fail, ducks...

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: The resulting amalgamation is certainly... interesting. Even if it doesn't exactly float on water.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You decide to name your toy Dr. Frankenfun (or maybe you should name it Dr. Frankenfun's Monster?). Just beholding the horror you've created gives you +2 FUN!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: That day at the lake, you start a Super Soaker fight that turns into an all-out war.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: The enemy team manages to capture the northern section of the lake, but you take a few of their members hostage and learn their empire's weaknesses.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You lead a full-scale infiltration. Thousands of soldiers get totally Soaked(TM). It's a bloodbath.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: After several hours, the enemy team surrenders, and you gain +2 FUN from the peace treaty. Yay!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You decide to bring a metal detector to the lake that day. You scour the beach for buried treasure.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You find a keychain, a tin box of stale cookies (which you eat anyway), a glowing chalice that the Knights Templar come to confiscate for some reason...

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: But best of all, you manage to find some genuine, silver-plated +2 FUN! Score!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You're in the lake, sunbathing. It's kinda relaxing... but hella boring.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: What's the issue? Have you lost your ability to have some fun unless you're playing videogames or partying in wild raves?

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Ah, no, you see the problem now: you didn't put on sunscreen, but FUNscreen, which has a fun protection factor of 50.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You wash the funscreen away with some water and put on some sunscreen. Theeere you go! You prevent some sunburn and gain +2 FUN.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You spend the day playing in the lake.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Everything is fun, until you're mesmerized by a strange song... IT'S THE SIRENS!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: They try to lure you with their beautiful chants, but you know better and challenge them to a Riff-Off!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: They kick your ass, but you all definitely have a lot of FUN. More specifically, +2 FUN.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You head to the lake to get your tan on, but as soon as you get there, it starts to rain!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Most of the beachgoers leave... but NO. You WILL enjoy a fun lake day, dammit. You had a really rough morning and you won't let anything else stop you from gaining FUN!!!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You aggressively splash in the lake and laugh as loudly as you can, hoping the clouds will give up on trying to ruin your day. Instead the lake gets struck by lightning.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: When you wake up from the electrocution coma, you're onshore, the sun is shining, and you have a cool new facial twitch! YOU WIN! You gain +2 FUN.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: While looking around the lake for a private place to take a pee, you find a treasure map buried in the sand!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: It leads to an X in the center of the lake. You gather a crew of trusted friends, don your eyepatch, and sail out there to find the booty!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: When you arrive, you find a tiny island with a single palm tree. You dig up a box that says "OPEN IN CASE OF A VERY BORING DAY."

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You open the box and find... +2 FUN! ARRRR!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: That day you bring a magazine to read by the lake. The cover story is "How to Gain FUN While Camping With Your Six Hottest, Most Charismatic Friends."

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: STEP ONE: Go to the lake. STEP TWO: Wait.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: What, that's it? Then why hasn't that worked for you yet--?

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Oh, wait, you just gained +2 FUN. Thanks, Cosmopolitan!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: That day in Monster Scouts, they teach you how to use the stars and trees' bark to find your way when you get lost...

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: ...On the internet.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: As a test, Coach leaves you in the middle of the internet. You easily get lost. Before you know it, you're watching the Spanish synchronized swimming team perform a routine based on "Stairway to Heaven."

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You don't earn the "Orientation While in the Internet" badge, but you definitely gain +2 CREATIVITY from watching such beautiful display of skill.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: That day there's a guest speaker at the Monster Scouts HQ. She's a Wereagle Monster Scout here to tell you all about advancing through the levels!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Her speech is surprisingly interesting! She started out at Camp Spooky, just like you, and worked super hard to earn every single badge!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: She also hints at some possible foul play, including her murdering a higher-level Scout and wearing her skin as a disguise in order to advance through the ranks.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Sure is inspiring! You're too busy flirting with your friends to dedicate that kind of time to Monster Scouts, but still, her speech instills you with +2 CREATIVITY.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: That day, the Monster Scouts hike around the camp cleaning up litter to "respect nature" and stuff.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Nobody but Coach gives a damn about picking up trash, but it does quickly become a contest to find the coolest garbage!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Some find used condoms, others find weirdly-shaped fruit. You somehow find a Rembrandt. It's an original.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: The mystery of how the Rembrandt ended up there will go on to trigger the most epic adventure you all will go on during this summer. But it won't happen on-screen.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: But you still gain +2 CREATIVITY just by looking at it. So magnificent!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: That day in Monster Scouts, you all learn to identify different animal tracks.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: First you practice identifying bears and deer, but then you start having to identify way more specific tracks.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You identify the tracks of a Sculptaur: half human, half sculptor. You follow the tracks until you find the legendary beast.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: The Sculptaur teaches you the basics of sculpture. You gain +2 CREATIVITY!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: That day in Monster Scouts, you all learn how to build scarecrows! That's vaguely nature-related, right?

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You decide to take it a step further, though: you add a magical crystal you found in a cave last month to your scarecrow to turn it into a SENTIENT BEING.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: The scarecrow is very grateful to have been made alive. You take your new friend out for a soda and have a very pleasant afternoon!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Then you're forced to disassemble him so the next group of Scouts can use the materials. Your scarecrow begs you not to relinquish your gift of life, but you're a dedicated Monster Scout first!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: The Scouts appreciate your dedication to the organization. You're awarded +2 CREATIVITY!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: That day in Monster Scouts you all practice writing speeches in preparation for possibly being killed by a bear. You wanna get your last words right!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You decide to write a heartfelt poem dedicated to your favorite things in life:

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Monster Camp, the smell of rain, the bittersweet joy of watching the sun set for the very last time, and chicken tenders.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Everyone is moved by your poem; you're pretty sure you even make the nearby bears cry. You gain +2 CREATIVITY.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: That day in Monster Scouts, you learn to make your very own clothes in the wild!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Someone suggests a fashion show, so afterwards you all put on your outfits and show them off.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: If you'd known that that would be the result, you probably would've made something other than a leaf-and-stick thong and vine-woven nipple tassels...

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Needless to say, nobody will be forgetting your performance anytime soon. You gain +2 CREATIVITY!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: That day in Monster Scouts, you make each other friendship bracelets!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: ...Except the Monster Scout leader pairs you randomly with your "friendship bracelet recipients", I guess so Larry the Lich doesn't feel left out for having no friends.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You get paired with Larry. Surprisingly, though, he's a great conversationalist, and he makes you a super heartfelt bracelet that imbues you with +2 CREATIVITY when you wear it!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Larry sure is nice... maybe there will come a day when he's cool enough to be your friend, or at least a romanceable summer fling option. But today is not that day!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: That day in Monster Scouts, you learn to identify different berries!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You all search for berries and try to identify them. A blackberry, a blueberry...

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: But Rachel the Deer-Person finds a very weirdly shaped berry no one can identify. You all stare at it for hours. It's closer to abstract art than to a berry, somehow.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: It's a true thinkpiece. It forces you to reflect on berry inequality, and although there are no easy answers to the questions it poses, you all gain +2 CREATIVITY from the experience.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You spend the day learning new skills with the Monster Scouts in order to earn badges!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You earn a badge for healing a wound only using the bark of a tree.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You earn a badge for writing poems in iambic pentameter.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You earn a badge for building a Blackberry using only real blackberries.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Nice! Completing all of those unexpected and probably useless lessons earned you +2 CREATIVITY!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You spend all day trying to learn how to use the North Star to know your location and never get lost.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: It's a fierce challenge, and everyone gets, like, super lost. You say fuck it and try to text the North Star to ask for directions. Maybe no one never asked?

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Of course this achieves nothing. It's a star, and you should stop trying to resort to sheer absurdity to solve your problems.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You get no badge (no one does, it was all a trick test and it wasn't even nighttime); but Coach awards you with +2 CREATIVITY for your lateral thinking.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: That day all the Scouts make a braid-chain as a teambuilding exercise. You learn all sorts of new ways to braid hair.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: But the person braiding your hair accidentally ties an Infinity Knot into your head. There's no way to untie it. YOU CAN SEE INTO INFINITY.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: But right before Coach gives you the worst haircut of your life, you see how all of your friends will die! It's useful in helping you eliminate David Davidson the Doomed Deer-Person from your romantic prospects.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You also watch every Marvel movie that will ever be released! You gain +2 CREATIVITY from witnessing so many plot twists.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: That day you happen to take the same Monster Scouts class as Mamimi the Oni Girl.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You didn't get good sleep last night, so you ask her if she has any of that weird energy drink she let you have once during high school.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: She doesn't, but she does have some very strange-smelling coffee that could help. Where does this girl even FIND these weird-ass drinks?

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: The coffee is delicious, but it comes with side effects: you get an acquired fear of caterpillars and you grow +2 CREATIVITY in your hair.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: That day you play Competitive Spin The Bottle.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You must kiss a camper from Camp Rival Camp. It's a long, intense kiss in which your tongues wrestle mercilessly.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You apply some unexpected biting (since that's currently very high on the meta) while holding the back of their head to prevent an untimely escape.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You win at kissing. It goes without saying you've earned +2 CHARM.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: That day at the Camp Dome, you play hacky-sack.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: It's all fun and games (literally) until the hacky-sack falls and -- against all your knowledge of hacky-sacks' supposed composition -- it breaks upon hitting the floor.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: What the fuck? The good news is inside of it there's... +2 CHARM? You call dibs.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: That day at the Camp Dome you play a game of tug-o-war.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You see, tug-o-war is a harder game than it seems. It involves a lot of strategy, and there's a secret technique not everyone knows. It's... "you need to be strong".

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You mastered this technique years ago, and so you win. The audience is cheering and roaring in joy while you salute them, victorious.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: They throw roses at you. They throw their underwear. Someone throws you +2 CHARM, which you happily take.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: That day at the Camp Dome you all do thumb wars.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: That means the campers are waging war against the Thumb Warriors, the supernaturally-buff thumb monsters from Camp Thumb. It's surprisingly terrifying.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You all were sure to lose -- but thanks to your quick thinking, you hatch a plan to fight the thumb warriors with their greatest weakness: PREDATORS WITHOUT OPPOSABLE THUMBS.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Some may say that your team siccing a pack of rabid mountain lions on the competitors is cheating, but you prefer the term "strategic". You gain +2 CHARM!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: That day at the Camp Dome, you all play the classic children's game "The Floor Is Lava" with a twist: the floor is literally lava.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You're all hopping here and there, trying to survive the dangers of... you know... lava. But then one of your teammates falls.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: He's sinking into the lava, dying a slow, agonizing death. You offer a hand but it's too late. Before disappearing under the hot lava he whispers his last words:

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%... you... your hair looks great.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: It does! You gain +2 CHARM from a nice compliment.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: That day at the Camp Dome you play Never Have I Ever XTREME. Every time someone mentions something you've done, you have to cut a finger off.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: But besides the finger part, this is finally a great time to brag about all the cool illegal things you've done!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You're the first out, and while they're sewing your digits back on, you get to regale your friends with stories of how you "robbed a bank while wearing your grandfather's skull as a hat."

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You're so cool! Also, they sew you +2 CHARM to your left hand by mistake.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Today at Camp Dome, the game is Seven Minutes in Heaven XTREME.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You volunteer yourself as tribute for your camp. You put on some lip balm, ready for some hot kissing... but it seems you got the rules wrong.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: In Seven Minutes in Heaven XTREME, they straight-up murder you and you need to stay in literal Heaven for seven minutes.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: They stab you repeatedly. You're sure you're going to Hell... but no. Heaven is beautiful, it's all you ever wanted. You want to stay, but they bring you back to life.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You are cheered by your teammates, but you will never be the same after being taken from Heaven. You do look more heavenly, tho... and that translates into +2 CHARM.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: While you're in the throes of battle at the Camp Dome, one of your teammates suddenly gets shot by three swift arrows.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: While slowly dying, he asks you to take the +2 CHARM he had hanging around his neck in a silver locket.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: It's a family heirloom. He wants you to take it to his father and tell him his son died in battle.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: While crying, you promise to do so. You'll honor his death.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Thing is, later you end up binge-watching 15 episodes of Garfield back to back, and you totally forget about your promise. Oopsies.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: That day at the Camp Dome you're doing some classic battle royale. Lots of fun and murder!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You've cornered another player, who begs you to spare her life.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You decide to spare her, but you still shoot an arrow in her spleen. Little-known fact: people store excess CHARM in there.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: She starts bleeding CHARM, so you take +2 CHARM and drink it. It refreshes you and makes your skin clearer.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Today, you're playing the most dangerous Camp Dome game of all... CHARM WARS!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: The rules are simple: you must gain CHARM by the end of the round, or YOU WILL DIE INSTANTLY.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, you better earn some charm quick! Like, in the next ten seconds or YOU'RE GONNA FUCKING DIE HOLY SHIT EARN SOME CHARM ALREADY--!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Oh! Okay, thank God. You just earned +2 CHARM. Phew, that was WAY too close!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: That day you join the merciless trials of the Camp Dome.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Your team is faced with a potato sack race.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: It seems easy... but this is THE CAMP DOME, and so the potato sacks are filled with swarms of bees!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Your teammates are discouraged, both because they are not fond of bees and because the enemy team is mostly comprised by sentient bees (aren't all bees sentient anyway?), giving them a clear advantage over you.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: It all looks dire for you... but you use your cunning and remind the enemy team that the bee population of Earth is inexplicably decreasing and bees are heading towards unavoidable extinction!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: This fact really messes with the enemy team's heads, giving you the edge you need to win. Your nasty leadership skills grant you +2CHARM!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Today at the Camp Dome, the game is Charades XTREME.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: It's just regular charades, but apparently they love to stick "XTREME" onto any classic game.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: It's your turn, and you get "THIRD TIME'S THE CHARM". "Third" is easy to convey just by using your fingers.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: But "Charm" is harder... to get your team to guess it right, you act as if you were more charming than you really are.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You manage to do that, gain +2 CHARM by playing that role, and bring your team to victory. Hooray!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You're huddled behind a bullet bunker in the throes of a tail tag battle royale against Camp Rival Camp. You're sure that this is the end.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You've lived a good life, you think. Next to you is a Camp Rival Camp member, shivering and crying and out of ammo (why guns are part of tail tag is beyond your comprehension).

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Is this where we die, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? they sob. "Why couldn't Camp Spooky and Camp Rival Camp just make love and not war?"

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You reach for them, as if to bring them into a tender kiss... and as soon as they're in your grasp, you take their tail.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: FUCK YEAH! That gives Camp Spooky the win! Everyone saw your sexy ruse, which also gives you +2 CHARM.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: That day, a fun and zany scavenger hunt awaits you at the Camp Dome.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Last night, the counselors stole your organs while you were asleep, and you have to solve the scavenger hunt clues to get them back! Isn't that fun? No? TOO BAD!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You make the best of the situation by stealing your hotter friends' organs in place of your own. You get +10 EVIL from Dmitri's liver!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You also find a very strange gland, and against common sense you shove it up your nose. It secretes +2 CHARM.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: It's a typical bloody Camp Dome battle royale. While you're hiding to catch a breath, a severed fist flies through the air and lands in your lap.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You unfold it. The fist was holding a tarnished silver locket containing the photo of a loved one, likely waiting for the hand's former owner to return home safely.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You toss that behind you and also find a crumpled-up coupon redeemable for +2 CHARM at Pedro's Pastrami Paradise!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Rad! Thanks, mysterious hand!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: Another day at Camp Dome, another day trying to survive a deadly battle royale game.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You manage to murder ten people in twenty minutes. What a feat.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: The audience roars. This will certainly give you a lot of BOLDNESS.

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: But wait! The Camp Dome shouldn't make you gain BOLDNESS, but CHARM! Even if that doesn't make sense! You want CHARM!

Speaker: narrator
Original Text: You think quickly and make a fancy hat out of the guts of a corpse. The audience is wowed and grants you +2 CHARM. Much better!
